scope: All effective default public database-role SELECT grants on negative-ID system objects in a newly created user database, including compatibility catalog views not listed in sys.system_objects.

capture_environment.container_lifecycle: fresh digest-pinned container per SQL Server profile; removed after capture

canonicalization.field_encoding: UTF-16 code-unit length, colon, exact value; concatenated in field order
canonicalization.ordering: schema, name, type_desc, state_desc, permission_name, minor_id; binary/ordinal order
canonicalization.source: sys.database_permissions; OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME/OBJECT_NAME; sys.system_objects.type_desc or OBJECTPROPERTYEX(IsView) fallback for system compatibility views.
